how_it_works: STAGING shows production pages, except pages listed here, which show the candidate source instead. Candidate sources are kept in production form under .github/staging-candidates/<same path as docs/>. After explicit user approval, .github/workflows/jra-ui-promote-v1.yml copies them byte-for-byte into docs/ and removes the entry.
